main.description: A comment. Record key: {fk}-{rootTid}-{tid}, where rootTid is the TID of the root post's key.

root.description: The thread's post; cid is the version replied to.

parent.description: The comment replied to (same thread); absent means top-level.

forum.description: at-uri of the forum declaration; MUST equal the root post's forum.

quote.description: Quoted text, anchored in parent if present, otherwise in root.

retracted.description: Retracted by the author; rendered struck through.

moderatorHat.description: Written as a moderator; shown only if the author is a current authority.

createdAt.description: Set once at creation by the writer's clock; never changed.
